name: Birthday Greeting Email Workflow
description: Receives employee data from the orchestrator for employees whose birthday (DD.MM of dateOfBirth) matches today. Uses a SAP Agent to generate a personalized birthday greeting email body, then logs the email. Replace the log node with an email node when a provider is configured.

parameters.chatInput: ={{ 'Write a warm and cheerful birthday greeting email for ' + $json.employeeName + '. Address them by first name. Keep it to 3-4 sentences. Return only the email body text, no subject line.' }}

parameters.content: This configuration is hardcoded — the values in this node reflect what you provided. Replace the Log node with a Microsoft Outlook or other email node when an email provider is configured.

Generate Birthday Email.response: Dear Shekhar, wishing you a very happy birthday filled with joy and laughter! On this special day, we want you to know how much you are appreciated and valued by the entire team. May this year bring you wonderful new achievements both personally and professionally. Have a fantastic birthday!
